────────────────────
+ This ~ Char

~ \s v \value \s
    v

.. nul ~
    ~ "null"
        null
.. bool ~
    ~ "true"
        true
    ~ "false"
        false
.. float Float ~
    ~ "-"? "." [0-9]+
    ~ "-"? [0-9]+ ("." [0-9]+)
.. int Int ~
    ~ "-"? "0"
    ~ "-"? [1-9] [0-9]*
.. string ~
    ~ "\"" text \chars? "\""
        text ?? ""
.. array ~
    ~ "[" \s items \delimited(~ \s "," \s, ~ \value)? \s "]"
        items ?? empty
            .. empty [JSON]

.. object ~
    ~ "{" \s pairs \delimited(~ \s "," \s, ~ \pair)? \s "}"
        (pairs! as [String = JSON]) if pairs ?? empty
            .. empty [String = JSON]

.. value JSON ~
    ~ \nul | \bool | \float | \int | \string | \array | \object

.. pair ~
    ~ left \string \s ":" \s right \value
        KeyValuePair(left, right)

.. chars String ~
    ~ chars \char*
        Array(chars).slice-string()

.. char ~
    ~ "\\u" hx \hex'U32
        hx as Char
    ~ "\\" c \json-escape-character
        unescape(c)
    ~ !"\"" .
        it as Char

.. json-escape-character ~
    ~ [bfnrt"]
    ~ "/"
    ~ "\\"

.. s ~
    ~ \wsnl*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+ to-json String
    - value
    = match value

| Null!
    "null"
| Int~
    "$value"
| Float~
    "$value"

| String~
    json-quote(value)
| list List~
    "[$joined]"
    .. joined = ", ".join of items
    .. items = to-json(each) in list
| map Map~
    "{$joined}"
    .. joined = ", ".join of pairs
    .. pairs  = <* key, val in map
        "${json-quote(key)}: ${to-json(val)}"
| Bool~ {it}
    "true"
| Bool~ {it == false}
    "false"
??
    "null"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+ ¶ json-quote
    - value String

"${"".join of json-escaped(each) in value}"

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
+ json-escaped
    - c Char
    = match c

|= '"'
    "\\\""
|= '\\'
    "\\\\"
|= '\n'
    "\\n"
|= '\r'
    "\\r"
|= '\t'
    "\\t"
|= '\b'
    "\\b"
|= '\f'
    "\\f"
|? c < ' '
    "\\u00${(c as U8 as Hex)[2 .. < 4]}"
??
    c as String

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
_ unescape
    - c
    = match c

| 't'
    "\t"
| 'n'
    "\n"
| 'r'
    "\r"
| 'b'
    "\b"
| 'f'
    "\f"
| '/'
    "/"
| '\\'
    "\\"
| '"'
    "\""
??
    ""

` =================================================================================================
` _ property-pairs'Object
`     - object
`
` "[$joined]"
`
` .. joined = ", ".join of pairs
` .. pairs = "\"$each.name\": $value" in Object.properties
`     .. value = to-json(object.$each.name)

` =================================================================================================
` _ from-json'Object
`     - o [String = JSON]
`
` . object = Object()
` for key, value in o
`     . found = set-property(object, thing, value)
`     if found
`         object = found!
`     ` else
`         ` -- "Mystery: $key ($object)"
`         ` ?! Error("Unable to restore property $key")
` = object

` =================================================================================================
` _ set-property'Object
`     - object Object
`     - thing JSON
`     - key String
`
` for $prop in Object.properties
`     if $prop.name == key
`         $if Object.isTuple
`             object = object.$prop = thing as $prop.type
`         else
`             object.$prop = thing as $prop.type
`         = object
`

+ do begin-using

`XXXjoe Create a unique timer id and save it! Don't be casting the semaphore ptr to a uid!!

do new
    . elapsed = Interval(0)
    if start-time > 0
        . us = start-time as Microseconds
        =? if C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilTime(us, lock.native-pointer)

        elapsed = start-time
        channel <- elapsed

    . us = increment as Microseconds
    while true
        if C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilTime(us, lock.native-pointer)
            break

        elapsed += increment
        if end-time && elapsed >= end-time
            break
        else
            channel <- elapsed

C:yumiCancelTimerEventListener(lock.native-pointer)

────────────────────

. t1 = clock()
. t = duration
while true
    if C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilTime(t, sem.native-pointer)
        break

    fn()
    . diff = t1.elapsed'Microseconds()
    . place = diff % duration
    t = duration - (diff % duration)

=? if !callback

=? if waiting

do new
    =? if wait-until-absolute-time(deadline-ns, sem)
    waiting = false
    fire(deadline-ns)

────────────────────
_ do fire
    - deadline-ns U64

=? if !callback
=? if !dirty

dirty = false
painting = true
last-deadline-ns = deadline-ns
do finally
    painting = false

callback!()

if callback && dirty
    wait-then-fire(next-deadline(monotonic-time-nanoseconds()))

    - now U64

|? !last-deadline-ns || !interval-ns
    now
|? next > now
    next
??
    last-deadline-ns + (((now - last-deadline-ns) / interval-ns) + 1) * interval-ns

.. next = last-deadline-ns + interval-ns

+ do wait-until-absolute-time
    - deadline-ns U64
    - sem Semaphore

` Keep absolute deadlines at the API boundary, but sleep through the relative timer path; repeated
` native absolute waits can miss their resume.
. now = monotonic-time-nanoseconds()
=? if deadline-ns <= now

. delay-ns = deadline-ns - now
. delay = (delay-ns as Nanoseconds) as Microseconds
=? if delay <= 0

= C:yumiSuspendActiveTaskUntilTime(delay, sem.native-pointer)
